premise: IShowSpeed's 'Ronaldo Day' Clip Becomes A Powerful Brainrot Meme

sources.text: Happy Day, Ronaldo Day is a series of memes, including brainrot edits, based on a viral video clip of streamer IShowSpeed skating and singing, "Happy day, Ronaldo day," then getting body-checked into the wall by a hockey player.

The clip comes from a video uploaded to IShowSpeed's YouTube channel in 2024, in which he learns to play hockey with NHL player Cole Caufield. The clip went viral in 2026 and was popularized as a meme that September. Some of the most popular memes include accuracy reenactments and stylized video edits.

Happy Day, Ronaldo Day
is a series of

The clip comes from a video uploaded to IShowSpeed's
YouTube

Origin
On June 14th, 2024, YouTuber
[1]
IShowSpeed uploaded a video titled "IShowSpeed Learns Hockey with Cole Caufield," garnering over 5.4 million views in two years. At the 4:00 timestamp, Speed skates down the ice singing, "Happy day, Ronaldo day," a reference to
footballer
Cristiano Ronaldo
. He is then checked into the wall.
Spread
The "Ronaldo Day" clip was reposted online several times in 2026. For example, on June 29th, 2026,
Instagram
[2]
user suubwway posted the clip with the caption, "Speed started crying," garnering over 21,600 likes in three months.
In September 2026, the clip became a more widespread subject of edits and memes. On September 20th, 2026, TikToker
[3]
@goldendandelion74 posted a brainrot edit of the clip that gained over 925,000 views in five days.
